description: This file defines a PHP class CustomerTransaction within the Opencart admin model extension. It provides methods to retrieve customer transaction data and total transaction counts from the database, with support for various filters.

classes.name: CustomerTransaction
classes.description: A model class in the OpenCart admin extension for handling customer transaction data retrieval.

methods.name: getTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer transactions based on provided filters, supporting pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getTotalTransactions
methods.description: Returns the total number of customer transactions matching specified filters.
